name: The Hydration Missile
why: Heavy stainless steel full of cold brew makes a truly devastating projectile.

lines.intro: Drink up, folks! Here comes thirty-two ounces of pure blunt force!
lines.hit: Right in the teeth! Now that is what I call aggressive hydration!
lines.miss: Clattered off the floor without leaving a single sip!
lines.parried: Reflected! That metallic clink is the sound of total regret!
